summary: Sublette County lookout named on a 1954 forest map and a 1968 USGS map, with a 1955 dedication item; listed as gone, with no build date or site description.

facts.status_note: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks it Gone and gives its type as Unknown. No source gives a removal date.

events.note: Dedication on the summit of Crow's Nest lookout, from a 'Twenty Years Ago This Week' column printed August 18, 1955. The year is inferred from the column's title; the item does not state it.
Pinedale District forest map lists a Crow's Nest lookout. The Forest Service history says it cannot tell whether a structure stood there.
USGS topographic map sheet portraying 1968 (published 1973) labels a Crows Nest Lookout.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1955 column speaks of the summit of Crow's Nest lookout. The Forest Service history says it cannot tell whether the 1954 lookouts were real structures or temporary fixtures. The story reports both and does not say a structure stood there.
The item is printed August 18, 1955 under a 'Twenty Years Ago This Week' heading, so the event probably dates to about 1935. The story gives the print date and the inferred year.

notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, design or removal date appears in any source read. The 1955 dedication is a reprint in a 'Twenty Years Ago This Week' column, so the event year of about 1935 is inferred and the story says 'probably'. The Forest Service history (Report BT-02-637, hosted by the NPS History E-Library) treats the 1954 Pinedale lookouts as uncertain, while the 1955 item calls Crow's Nest a lookout on a summit; the story reports both. The Pastmaps page is a site description: its map label, the portrayed date (1968) and the published date (1973) are the parts relied on. The record's coordinates (42.65022, -109.21911) were not checked against any source. The original 1955 Pinedale Roundup was not read.
